_doc: Window 5 run list (2026-09-23). Two questions: (1) HEADLINE on the tip only - J --cfg default with --broadphase tree and allpairs at W 1/2/4/8, rest both ways at W 1/8; (2) G9-ON-C3 - PARENT (0ca312bd, C2 + tree, no C3) vs TIP (cbd86a65, + L11 C3 warm_apply_avx2) interleaved on J-As (--cfg as) at W 1/8, then the armed twins J-As-a (--arm-profiler, --csv) at W 1/8.

Row spellings: HL-D-* = window 4's T-D-* (--scene jolt --gap 0.5 --cfg default --broadphase tree|allpairs); HL-R-* = window 4's R-* (--scene rest --cfg default --broadphase tree|allpairs, 500 steps); J-As / J-As-a = window 4b's J-As / J-As-a (--scene jolt --gap 0.5 --cfg as; the cfg sets AllPairs, Manual select, simd_solve on).

Every process: --workers W --steps 500 --window 0..500 --csv <cwd>/run.csv --pose-out <cwd>/pose.bin --label <id>#<binary>@W<W> [--arm-profiler] --expect-pose gate/<pose_ref>_ref.pose (the parent's untimed gate pose: J = parent HL-D-allpairs W1, R = parent HL-R-allpairs W1).

Expected poses (task): J (cfg default both arms, cfg as, armed) 0x32d5e235342b4143; rest 0xee2a67a98434919a. Expected TreeDiag (task): tree rows static_rebuilds 1, members 1, evictions 0; allpairs rows every field 0.
Jolt v5.6.0 is NOT re-run: window 3's cells 9.828 / 5.770 / 3.581 / 2.569 / 2.388 ms at W 1/2/4/8/16 are the only reference (owner ruling).

protocol.order: per block, pass 0: W ascending; inside a W group row by row in this file's order (tree then allpairs; parent then tip); pass 1: the whole list reversed
protocol.warmup_per_pass: one untimed process per pass: headline = tip HL-D-tree W=8; g9/armed = tip J-As W=8
protocol.idle_rule: tools/wait_idle5.ps1: 0 build procs (cargo/rustc/link/miri/...) AND 0 procs from D:/wt/_targets or D:/wt/mq-* on 3 consecutive 60-s polls, 10-s cpu < 5 %; up to 120 polls (120 min) per wait
